name: Maze of Terror
detailed_description:
In the shadows of the unknown, something terrifying awaits…

Maze of Terror throws you into ever-changing, procedurally generated labyrinths filled with deadly traps, mind-bending puzzles, and horrifying creatures. There is only one goal - survive, complete the mission, and find your way out… if you can.

“Every time it’s different. Every time, more terrifying. The walls shift, the paths deceive, and the monsters… they remember you.”

You are not a hero. You're a survivor - one step away from being prey.

Alone or with others...

Step into the maze alone for a true test of courage, or join forces with up to 4+ friends in a co-op mode where every player has a role. Cover each other, solve puzzles faster, and watch each other’s backs… because the maze won’t.

Complete the mission. Escape the horror.

You’re not just wandering. Each run has a purpose. Find lost artifacts, uncover hidden secrets, disable arcane mechanisms - and make it out alive.

  • 🔧 Randomly generated mazes - no two runs are ever the same

  • 👹 Dynamic monsters that stalk and hunt based on sound, light, and your fear

  • 🪤 Deadly traps - from spike pits to cursed symbols and shifting walls

  • 🎧 Voice interaction - optional voice recognition lets the maze hear your fear...

  • 🛑 No mic? No problem. Use the command system to interact and survive

Don’t let it find you…

The maze listens. The maze learns. The longer you stay, the more hostile it becomes. Every sound you make, every wrong turn you take - it sees it all.

Will you conquer the Maze of Terror, or will you become just another forgotten soul lost in its depths?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600 / AMD Ryzen 3 3100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 14 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Microphone is recommended

content_descriptors.notes: The game features depictions of mutilated monster corpses with slight human resemblance, as well as imagery of skulls, bones, and blood. It also includes scenes of human killings using various bladed and blunt weapons, presented without additional graphic gore.
